# MDL401 · `unknown-option`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A key of [mydumper] or [myloader] is not an option of the target version.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | options |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | F6, G3, G4, G13 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl401-unknown-option-fatal-or-ignored`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl401-unknown-option-fatal-or-ignored.txtar) |

## Why

mydumper passes every key of its group to GLib's option parser as `--key value`. A name that is not one of the version's options is an unknown option: mydumper up to v1.0.0-1 aborts at startup (`option parsing failed: Unknown option --key`), later versions ignore it without a word, so the setting silently does nothing.

Common causes: leading dashes (`--threads=4` becomes `----threads`), a short name (`t` instead of `threads`), case (`Routines`), `_` instead of `-` (`split_string_pk`), an option of the other tool (`outputdir` in [myloader]), or an option added or removed in another version. The fix renames the key when exactly one option matches after normalization.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
Chunk_Filesize=64
Routines=1
```

```text
2:1-2:15 error MDL401[unknown-option] `Chunk_Filesize` is not a mydumper option in v0.19.3-3: the option is `chunk-filesize` (option names are case-sensitive; GLib does not treat `_` and `-` alike)
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Unknown option --Chunk_Filesize, try --help".
  fix (unsafe): Rename the key to `chunk-filesize`
3:1-3:9 error MDL401[unknown-option] `Routines` is not a mydumper option in v0.19.3-3: the option is `routines` (option names are case-sensitive)
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Unknown option --Routines, try --help".
  fix (unsafe): Rename the key to `routines`
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[mydumper]
chunk-filesize=64
routines=1
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL401: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL401` on the line above it.
